span.p:
The light is ignored in IDLE and COMPLETED:
a green LED only means coffee inside a session.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
A START pressed while the machine is still green
never alerts: the session first waits for the
machine to leave that state. A green flash
during the wait restarts the OFF window.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
"ON" comes from the hysteresis (≥ lightOnThreshold,
off again ≤ lightOffThreshold); a green shorter than
readyConfirmationMs restarts the ON window.
START in STARTING / BREWING / READY ⇒ StartIgnored.
Invalid readings freeze the session; on recovery
the window in progress restarts.
